name: Classic Steel Water Tower

era.notes: Riveted municipal steel tower; repainting and preservation can retain it into the present. No service date or town name is assumed.

axes: glTF Y up; front service gate +Z
origin: Ground at midpoint of front fence/gate edge (two art pixels ahead of gate)

sign_name.runtime: Separate curved panel; preserve face UVs and write inside the blank region without scaling pixels. No letters or generated town name baked in.

ladder.notes: Rear fixed ladder with cage, catwalk transition and roof ladder; service access is visual only.

door_exemption: Uninhabitable tower: no Go inside doorway. access_ladder is a maintenance anchor, not a door. service_gate remains visibly closed.

collision.strategy: One full-height exclusion box for the visibly fenced closed maintenance compound. Walking under the tower and climbing are deliberately unavailable.
collision.gate: Do not open service_gate or allow entry without replacing this compound collider with detailed structural collision/navigation.

lot_notes: Only gravel pad is removable. Fence, legs, footings and collision remain part of the structure.
runtime_handoff: No water pressure/storage/utility or climbing simulation is implemented.
Tank town-name binding remains runtime work; default panel is blank.
Red marker is a steady emissive preview; no blinking or aviation behavior is implied.
Landmark importer must hide collision from rendering.
licence: LimeZu pavement: Timerpg use only, original credit required. Original geometry and other pixel art.
renders: Blender desktop previews, not Filament or S25 captures.
